verdict.rationale: INPI is a public IP office offering online filing and searchable databases, so headless or CI automation is a fair question. However, no evidence pack item documents a CLI, API, or non-interactive way to run its procedures in automation. The only relevant item is a probe showing data.inpi.fr returns HTTP 403 to keyless requests, which notes that a token is needed but does not document any headless or CI workflow.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
